_about: How each fact is obtained when a document is validated. Reviewed by people; the fact catalog uses it. kind: DOCUMENT (on the document / register), DERIVED (Python works it out from other facts: list them in the fact's derived_from), LOOKUP (from a table, e.g. rate from HSN), ASK (from the user or ERP). A fact not listed here is DOCUMENT, or DERIVED when AKP recorded derived_from. Add a line per fact as you confirm it, e.g. "F_SUPPLY_CONSIDERATION": {"kind": "ASK", "how": "from the contract / ERP"}
